1. Open the site's home page.
2. Search for a title.
3. Open a movie or show page.
4. Press play and let the video start.
5. Tap Generate on the Logs tab.

Deep capture (on by default, ⋮ menu) records status codes, headers, cookies and response bodies. Turn it off if a site misbehaves.

Android can\'t safely run another app\'s APK inside this one, and you don\'t need to. Record the app\'s traffic with PCAPdroid (per-app, no system certificate — your banking apps are never touched), export a PCAP, and Import it here to get the app\'s endpoints. Then open those hosts in the Browser tab to capture the real API — most streaming apps share their website\'s API.
